title: 3D Totem of Undying by ponchik1m2d3a
description: Hello, guys! This Resourse Pack adds a 3D Totem of Undying. It's also for HMI.
body:
Hello, guys. This Resourse Pack adds a 3D Totem of Undying. I like doing some Resourse Packs but it's a bit too long to do them for me. I want to do some cool Resourse Packs but I don't have enought time. And yes, it's first time uploading some stuff Public on an Open Source for me. Oh!! I almost forgot! This Resourse Pack supports [HMI (Hold my Items)](https://modrinth.com/mod/hold-my-items)! See you soon (if we can)!

By "ponchik1m2d3a" on TLauncher.
